usageNotes: Call this endpoint to retrieve the top-level directory index of the Proxmox Datacenter Manager API — useful for discovery, connectivity testing, or confirming that a PDM host is reachable and responding. No parameters are required and no special privileges beyond a valid API token are needed. This is the lightest possible call to verify authentication credentials are accepted.

examples.summary: Verify PDM API reachability with an API token

tips: Because this endpoint accepts all authenticated users, it is safe to use as a health-check or smoke-test in automation before issuing more privileged calls.
The PDM API listens on port 8443 by default; ensure firewall rules allow TCP 8443 from your client.
Returns null per spec — the value of this call is the HTTP 200 response code, not the response body.
